selected_training: Fine-tuned from the deployed Version 2 checkpoint on the complete leak-audited Roboflow Version 3 dataset

reviewed_84_image_check.scope: Top-class recognition check using the reviewed filename-code mapping; not bounding-box mAP

auxiliary_speed_limit_reader.deployment_reason: The prototype CNN rejected too many live-camera crops. YOLO remains the detector and fallback while OCR may refine a numeric value without blocking speech.
auxiliary_speed_limit_reader.behaviour: Retained only as an offline experiment and not called by the web application.
auxiliary_speed_limit_reader.evaluation_note: Prototype test split has only 24 speed-limit instances and 33.3% accepted coverage; this CNN remains an offline experiment.

speed_limit_ocr.preprocessing: 12% inner crop, grayscale, and upscale short crops to at least 96 pixels high
speed_limit_ocr.fallback: Keep the original YOLO numeric class whenever OCR is unavailable, invalid, or below the override threshold.
speed_limit_ocr.speech_policy: OCR never blocks an announcement; the existing camera confidence, spatial matching, temporal confirmation, and cooldown remain authoritative.
